ddl:
CREATE TABLE Ticket_Type (
    Description VARCHAR(255),
    Includes_Workshop VARCHAR(255),
    Name VARCHAR(255),
    Price FLOAT,
    Ticket_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY
);

CREATE TABLE Discount_Code (
    Amount FLOAT,
    Discount_Code_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Name VARCHAR(255),
    Type VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE Meeting (
    Date DATETIME,
    Description VARCHAR(255),
    End_Time DATETIME,
    Meeting_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Name VARCHAR(255),
    Room VARCHAR(255),
    Start_Time DATETIME
);

CREATE TABLE Workshop (
    Capacity INTEGER,
    Date DATETIME,
    Description VARCHAR(255),
    End_Time DATETIME,
    Location VARCHAR(255),
    Name VARCHAR(255),
    Requirements VARCHAR(255),
    Start_Time DATETIME,
    Workshop_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY
);

CREATE TABLE Speaker (
    Bio VARCHAR(255),
    Company VARCHAR(255),
    Name VARCHAR(255),
    Speaker_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY
);

CREATE TABLE Participant (
    Company VARCHAR(255),
    Discount_Code_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Email VARCHAR(255),
    Name VARCHAR(255),
    Participant_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Ticket_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (Discount_Code_ID) REFERENCES Discount_Code(Discount_Code_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Ticket_ID) REFERENCES Ticket_Type(Ticket_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Meeting_Speaker (
    Meeting_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Speaker_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (Meeting_ID, Speaker_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Meeting_ID) REFERENCES Meeting(Meeting_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Speaker_ID) REFERENCES Speaker(Speaker_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Workshop_Speaker (
    Speaker_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Workshop_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (Workshop_ID, Speaker_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Speaker_ID) REFERENCES Speaker(Speaker_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Workshop_ID) REFERENCES Workshop(Workshop_ID)
);
gold_question:
The design of a technology conference management system is as follows:
The conference has participants, whose information includes Participant ID, Name, Company, and Email.
The conference offers various types of tickets, with ticket information including Ticket ID, Name, Description, Price, and whether it includes workshops, with each participant limited to purchasing one ticket.
Participants can use discount codes to purchase tickets, with discount code information including Code, Name, Type, and Amount.
After purchasing tickets, participant ticket records are generated, containing Participant ID, Ticket ID, Discount Code ID, and Net Price.
The conference schedules multiple meetings, with meeting information including Name, Description, Date, Start Time, End Time, and Room.
Furthermore, the conference also offers workshops, with workshop information including Name, Description, Requirements, Location, Date, Start Time, End Time, and Capacity.
Each meeting or workshop can have multiple speakers, with speaker information including Name, Company, and Description.
nl_text: The rschema_0350 database contains eight tables that are used to store information about a conference. The Ticket_Type table contains information about the different types of tickets that can be purchased for the conference, including the name, description, price, and whether or not it includes a workshop. The Discount_Code table contains information about the different discount codes that can be used to get a discount on the cost of a ticket, including the name, type, and amount of the discount. The Meeting table contains information about the different meetings that will be held during the conference, including the date, time, location, and description. The Workshop table contains information about the different workshops that will be held during the conference, including the date, time, location, and description. The Speaker table contains information about the different speakers who will be giving presentations during the conference, including their name, company, and bio. The Participant table contains information about the different participants who will be attending the conference, including their name, company, email, and discount code. The Meeting_Speaker table contains information about the speakers who will be giving presentations at each meeting, including the meeting and speaker. The Workshop_Speaker table contains information about the speakers who will be giving presentations at each workshop, including the workshop and speaker.
